figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Molecular network of the FR molecular family from Ardisia
leaves (Sephadex LH-20 fraction). Nodes display distinct m/z
features, displaying their parent mass. Width of edges is proportional
to cosine. Sizes of the nodes correspond to number of species it is
found in (small nodes all stem from A. crenata extract). Highlighted in
red are FR and the structurally related derivatives FR-1 to FR-4 (1−
4). Orange-labeled nodes are FR analogues 5−9, lacking the side
chain N-propionylhydroxyleucine2. For (putative) structures of 1−9,
see Schemes S1 and S2 (Supporting Information).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Bioactivity of FR, 1, 2, and 3/4 (3:1 ratio). (A) Inhibition of agonist-induced second messenger production in CHO cells expressing the
Gq-sensitive muscarinic M1 receptor. Indicated analogues were evaluated against the muscarinic agonist carbachol at its EC80. (B) Competition
binding study of FR, 1, 2, and 3/4 (3:1 ratio) versus [3H]PSB-15900 (5 nM), the tritiated derivative of FR, by cell membrane preparations of
platelets. Values represent means ± SEM of three independent experiments. pIC50 values ranging between 7.79 and 8.64 were determined.
